subject.title: feat: announce critical session health beyond the rail and teach companion delegation

question: Should all operator.read session-event subscribers receive critical background-session digests, and should webchat agents be explicitly directed to the session companion instead of using agent turns for status explanations?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes recipient semantics and model-facing behavior rather than repairing an established broken contract; correctness tests cannot determine the intended permanent operator and agent-policy boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the broader announce
options.body: Approve the operator.read-wide critical-digest audience and the companion guidance after confirming existing subscribers safely ignore or handle non-visible sessions.

options.title: Narrow the recipient contract
options.body: Keep the notice feature but add an explicit Control UI capability or subscription boundary so unrelated session-event consumers do not receive the broader digest stream.

options.title: Defer the feature direction
options.body: Pause this PR until the intended operator visibility and delegation policy are documented or resolved in a narrower design discussion.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the broader announce
recommendation.body: Approve the operator.read-wide critical-digest audience and the companion guidance after confirming existing subscribers safely ignore or handle non-visible sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author supplied the cross-cutting gateway, Control UI, and prompt rationale and is the best available routing candidate from the supplied history.
